# ATB23H3: Astrophysics
### University of Toronto Scarborough
Comprehensive course archive for theoretical astrophysics, radiative processes, stellar evolution, and numerical astrophysics simulations.
:::

::: {.card-grid}
::: {.course-card}
### 🌟 [Lecture Notes](notes/index.qmd)
Hydrostatic equilibrium, the Lane-Emden equation for polytropes, nuclear fusion cycles (p-p chain, CNO cycle), and Chandrasekhar mass limit.
:::

::: {.course-card}
### 🪐 [Problem Sets](problems/index.qmd)
Step-by-step solutions to orbital mechanics, tidal disruption limits (Roche limit), and black hole accretion physics.
:::

::: {.course-card}
### 🔭 [Simulations](simulations/index.qmd)
Python integrators for the Lane-Emden differential equation, stellar structure shooting methods, and N-body gravitational simulations.
:::
